history.administration_response: Based on the documents submitted in previous updates (the finalized strategic performance framework and the finalized country-based strategic results frameworks), closure of this recommendation is requested. Update provided in August 2021: the strategic performance framework of the Peacebuilding Fund was finalized in May 2021 and shared with donors and other partners. In addition, country-based strategic results frameworks have been finalized in Guatemala, Kyrgyzstan, South Sudan and the western Balkans.
history.board_assessment: Given that the PBF Performance Framework has been finalized and the Strategic Framework at national level have been started to establish, the Board consider this recommendation implemented.
